sources.title: Are 7b models useful? : r/LocalLLaMA - Reddit
sources.snippet: In my experience 7B models are mostly useful for creative writing, where their propensity for hallucination is an asset, not a drawback. That having been said, smaller models (7B and 3B) do much better with longer prompts. My rule of thumb with 7B models is to give them a prompt at least 440 characters long, and longer than that is better.
